questions.question: A SEV1 incident is still open on Tuesday morning. Can the regular 10 AM production deployment go ahead?
questions.ground_truth: No. Production deployments are frozen while a SEV1 is active, including scheduled Tuesday and Thursday deployments.
questions.answer: No, the scheduled 10 AM production deployment cannot proceed while a SEV1 incident is still open; all production deployments are frozen until the incident commander closes the incident.

questions.question: A data breach involving personal data has been confirmed. Who must be notified immediately, and what is the deadline for telling regulators?
questions.ground_truth: security@arishem.com and the General Counsel immediately; regulators within 72 hours.
questions.answer: If a data breach involving personal data has been confirmed, the incident response runbook requires that security@arishem.com and the General Counsel be notified immediately. Additionally, the relevant regulators must be notified within 72 hours of the breach being confirmed.
